name: Bournemouth University
description: Bournemouth University is a public university with its main campus situated in neighbouring Poole. The university is recognized for its work in the media industries. Graduates from the university have worked on a number of Hollywood films, including Gravity, which was awarded the Achievement in Visual Effects Oscar at the 86th Academy Awards in 2015. Bournemouth is ranked #86 in the UK, but is a solid mid-ranked university which is very popular. In 2017 Bournemouth University received a silver rating in the Teaching Excellence Framework, a government assessment of the quality of undergraduate teaching in universities and other higher education providers in England.
